What I know is what's in the world — the Colombian department, the river, the jungle, one of the last places where the Amazon basin begins to press against the Andes. FARC territory for decades. More recently: the children found alive after the plane crash in 2023, forty days in that forest, the youngest two years old.\n\nIs that what you're bringing? Or something else under that name?","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
